name: Student Mental Health Hub

steps.text: The Student Activity Center is near Vilas Communications Hall, Walgreens and Milio's.
Go in by the pillar marked 333, through the double doors with the university’s logo.
The Student Mental Health Hub is on the 3rd floor. After exiting the elevator, head straight, past the front desk.

source: Live page /about/mh-hub (its 'Accessing the Student Activity Center' section), read 2026-10-19. Its 3rd-floor plan and the inside of the Hub were saved from that page with the owner’s approval on 2026-10-20; its entrance picture carries a clipart figure, so the same door is shown from the Caucus Room page.
